title: Rear-end collision: sudden stop, tailgating, phone use
description: Driver A braked hard for a dog crossing the road. Driver B, following closely while looking at a phone, rear-ended A. A's registration had expired.

scene.location: El Camino Real near Oak Ave

actions.description: Vehicle registration expired three months earlier.
Approx. 0.6 s headway at 35 mph per dashcam frame analysis.
Phone records show an outgoing text 4 seconds before impact.

evidence.summary: B's vehicle very close behind for 10+ s before the stop.
Notes short following distance; notes A's expired registration.
Text sent 4 s before the collision time.
